description: Browse/search Statbel (Statistics Belgium, be.STAT) saved statistical views. Each view is a pre-built table over a dataset and carries a single locale (nl/fr/de/en). Returns id, name, locale, dataSourceId and publish dates. Filter by case-insensitive substring of the view name (matches in any language).

locale.description: Optional filter to one language: "nl", "fr", "de" or "en".

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match in the view name (any language). Omit to list all.

name: list_views
title: List Views
